name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
summary: Ocarina of Time as a native Linux game: HarbourMasters' Ship of Harkinian, built from your own copy of the game.
description:
Ship of Harkinian is HarbourMasters' PC port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, built on the game's decompilation. It runs natively (no emulator, no Proton) at any resolution and frame rate, with widescreen, the randomizer, mods, and an in-game menu full of enhancements and accessibility options.

The game's data comes from your own copy: any N64 version (USA, Japan or Europe, 1.0 to 1.2), a GameCube release, or Master Quest. piShop checks it and puts it in the game's folder; at the first start Ship of Harkinian builds its assets from it (oot.o2r, or oot-mq.o2r for Master Quest). Settings, saves and mods stay in the game's folder.
steamos: First start: Ship of Harkinian builds the game's assets from your ROM by itself, then asks whether to run the game: answer Yes. It only happens once.
Master Quest too: a second ROM (oot-mq.o2r) can be added later from the in-game menu.
